subject: The Settings dialog over the main window, open on General: the category rail (search box, sixteen categories with General highlighted, lock footer 'Local Epistemic Sovereignty'), the header with the General illustration, title and description, the LANGUAGE & REGION and STARTUP cards, and the footer 'Changes are saved as you make them.' with Close.
The category rail alone: 'Search settings…' box, the sixteen category buttons from General to Advanced with their icons (General active), and the lock footer.
region: The left rail of the Settings dialog, from the search box to the footer.

subject: The 'Autosave drafts every' row showing 45 s in its stepper, with the small reset-to-default arrow button before the stepper.
region: The single 'Autosave drafts every' row in the DRAFTS card.
setup: Afterwards click the reset arrow to put it back to 30 s.
steps: Click Reading & Writing in the rail
In DRAFTS, click + on 'Autosave drafts every' three times (30 s → 45 s)

subject: The Startup screen menu open, with Timeline ticked, then Knowledge Vault, Mind Graph and Agent Lab.
region: The Startup screen menu button and its open menu.
steps: In STARTUP, click the 'Timeline' menu button of Startup screen

subject: The Telemetry row with its green lock badge 'Always off'.
region: The Telemetry row of the PRIVACY card.
steps: Click Privacy & Data in the rail

subject: The Settings footer with the amber dot, 'Unsaved provider changes', Close and the primary 'Save & Apply Settings' button.
region: The footer bar of the Settings dialog.
setup: Do not save; close Settings afterwards to discard the change.
steps: Click AI & Models in the rail

subject: Settings searching for 'key': header 'Search results' and 'Matching settings: 5', results grouped under AI & Models (Provider and default model, Credentials, each with Show in AI & Models), Notifications (Model failures), Shortcuts (Keyboard shortcuts) and Advanced (Reset all settings) with 'key' highlighted, count badges beside those categories in the rail and the other categories dimmed.
Settings in a compact window: a thin icon-only rail, the search box above the header in the content column, the General category.
setup: Main window narrower than 900 px (the medium breakpoint), for example 860 × 900.
steps: Resize the window to 860 px wide

subject: The General category body: LANGUAGE & REGION (Interface language menu English, Date format chips, Time format chips, Number format menu, First day of the week chips) and STARTUP (Default persona 'Last used', Startup screen 'Timeline', Welcome tour 'Show again').
region: The header and body of the Settings content column.

subject: The Reading & Writing body: POSTS (Post length limit 280 chars, Split long drafts into a thread, Post as chips, Archive posts automatically 'Never', Symbol shorthand, Log my feelings in the journal), DRAFTS, LINKS & TAGS and FEED (Daily feed budget 'No limit').
region: The Settings content column, scrolled so POSTS is at the top; a second capture of the lower cards may be stitched.
steps: Click Reading & Writing in the rail

subject: The AI & Models provider pane as the demo profile has it: 'SELECT LLM PROVIDER' with 'Active: Custom Endpoint', six provider buttons in two rows (Google Gemini with '★ Recommended'; Custom Endpoint selected), 'Custom Endpoint API Key' with 'Stays on this computer', the key drawn as dots with the eye button at the end of the field, 'Custom Endpoint URL' (the local stub engine), 'Model Identifier' (no hint beside it) stub-thinker and the 'Presets:' chip default-model.
region: The top of the AI & Models content column, header included.
setup: The demo profile's capture stub engine (Custom Endpoint); nothing typed.
steps: Click AI & Models in the rail

subject: The REQUESTS card (Request timeout 60 s, Retries 2×) and the DAILY BUDGET card (Daily request budget No limit, Daily token cap No limit, Ask before spending on).
region: The REQUESTS and DAILY BUDGET cards.
steps: Click AI & Models in the rail

subject: The CREDENTIALS card with Add credential in its header, the note, the demo profile's 'Local engine' row (Custom Endpoint · ••••cret and its address) and a test 'Personal OpenAI key' row (OpenAI · ••••0000), each with pencil and bin icons.
region: The CREDENTIALS section of AI & Models.
setup: Add credential, chip OpenAI, Name 'Personal OpenAI key', API key test-0000 (a fake test value), Save credential. Remove it again afterwards with its bin icon.
steps: Click AI & Models in the rail

subject: The open credential form under the list: Service chips (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Groq, Custom Endpoint, Brave Search, Tavily, HTTP) with OpenAI filled, Name 'Personal OpenAI key', an API key field reading 'Paste the API key' with its eye button, Endpoint (optional) with its placeholder, Cancel and Save credential.
region: The CREDENTIALS section with the form open.
setup: Click Cancel (or fill the API key with a fake test value and save) afterwards.
steps: Click AI & Models in the rail
Type Personal OpenAI key in Name

subject: The Embeddings body as the demo profile has it: MODEL (Embedding provider 'Custom', Embedding model stub-embed, Local server address http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1, Vector size 256 dims, each with its reset arrow), CHUNKING (512 tokens, 64 tokens) and INDEX (Semantic search on, Rebuild, and Stop disabled since nothing is being indexed).
region: The Settings content column of Embeddings.

subject: The Images body: ENGINE (Default image engine 'No images', Image size 'Square', Style prefix with placeholder 'e.g. watercolor, soft light') and AVATARS (Draw avatars automatically off).
region: The Settings content column of Images.

subject: The Agents & Simulation body: AUTONOMY (Autonomous posting off, the 'Scheduler Off' status pill and lines, Rate limit 12 / hour, Concurrent generations 1 at once), QUIET HOURS (switch off, dimmed Quiet from 22:00 and Quiet until 07:00) and REPLIES (6 deep).
region: The Settings content column of Agents & Simulation.
steps: Click Agents & Simulation in the rail

subject: The scheduler status block: green 'Scheduler On' pill, the explanation ending 'Checked every 60s, one generation at a time.', and the queue line '0 generating · 0 queued'.
region: The scheduler status rows inside the AUTONOMY card.
setup: The demo profile's stub engine (Custom Endpoint). Turn Autonomous posting off again afterwards.
steps: Click Agents & Simulation in the rail

subject: The Learning body: REVIEWS (200 / day, 20 / day, 90%), REMINDER (switch off, dimmed Remind me at 09:00), WEEKLY REVIEW (switch off, dimmed Sunday and 18:00) and LANGUAGES (Language I am learning 'Español').
region: The Settings content column of Learning.

subject: The Import body: SPLITTING (Split documents by chips with Paragraph chosen, Post imports as chips with Yourself chosen) and FILES (Largest file 50 MB, Keep the original file on).
region: The Settings content column of Import.

subject: The Privacy & Data body: STORAGE (Database and Media folder paths in monospace, starting with … and ending in the vault folder and file, with Open folder), MAINTENANCE (Back up now, Export, Create snapshot, Restore, Clear) and PRIVACY (Fetch link previews on, Include journal in search off, Telemetry 'Always off').
region: The Settings content column of Privacy & Data.
steps: Click Privacy & Data in the rail

subject: The Notifications body: the IN-APP TOASTS card with Show toasts on, Confirmations on, Model failures on, Agent activity off, Due reminders on.
region: The Settings content column of Notifications.

subject: The Code body: RUNNING CODE (Run code blocks off, Time limit 10 s) and RUNTIMES (the note, 'Checked …' with Refresh, and rows Node, Deno, Python, Lua, Go with version and path (the home folder written ~) and their switches dimmed, then Ruby and PHP reading 'Not found' with no switch).
region: The Settings content column of Code.
setup: At least one runtime installed on the capture machine (for example Python).
steps: Click Refresh and wait until it no longer reads Checking…

subject: The Advanced body: DIAGNOSTICS (Log level 'Warnings', Developer options off) and RESET with the red filled button 'Click again to reset'.
region: The Settings content column of Advanced.
setup: Do not click a second time; close Settings afterwards.

subject: Settings open on Appearance: READING COMFORT card, then APPEARANCE MODE (Dark, Light, System chips, hint, Dark theme and Light theme menus) and the top of the THEME GALLERY.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer

subject: The APPEARANCE MODE card: Dark (chosen), Light and System chips, the hint 'System follows your computer's light or dark setting and switches with it.', 'Dark theme' menu showing Simulacra Midnight and 'Light theme' menu showing Graphite Light.
region: The APPEARANCE MODE section label and card.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer

subject: The title bar's appearance button (moon icon) with its tooltip 'Appearance: Dark (click for Light)'.
region: The toggle and its tooltip in the title bar.
steps: Hover the moon button in the title bar

subject: The READING COMFORT card: Reading width chips Narrow, Comfortable (chosen), Wide, and the Reduce motion switch off.
region: The READING COMFORT section label and card.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer

subject: The THEME GALLERY: the search field 'Search themes by name or author…', All / Dark / Light chips (All chosen), 'BUNDLED THEMES' and the first rows of preview cards, sharing each row evenly to the right edge of the pane, with Simulacra Midnight outlined and marked Active.
region: The THEME GALLERY section.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer

subject: The Simulacra Midnight gallery card: the mini post by Socrates-GPT (@socrates · 2m, 'Knowledge is a conversation that refuses to end.', dialectic chip, Post button) and the footer with name, Active badge and credit 'Simulacra'.
region: One gallery card.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer

subject: The CUSTOM THEME card on a bundled theme: 'Bundled themes are read-only. Duplicate one to edit its colors.', the Duplicate button, and the CONTRAST (WCAG 2.1) list with ratios and grade badges.
region: The CUSTOM THEME section.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer

subject: The CUSTOM THEME card editing 'Nord (Custom)': 'Editing Nord (Custom)', Duplicate and Reset to preset outlined and Delete in red, the fourteen colour pickers in two even columns across the card with labels (Background … Selection) and hex values, and the contrast list.
region: The CUSTOM THEME section.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer
Click the Nord card in the gallery

subject: The CONTRAST (WCAG 2.1) list of the Nord copy with Muted text set to #4c566a: the Text rows AAA, the three Muted text rows with red-outlined Fail badges, Accent label on accent AAA.
region: The contrast rows of the CUSTOM THEME card.
setup: A custom theme (duplicate Nord) whose Muted text colour is set to #4c566a (close to the background). A pale accent does not fail: the label on it turns dark by itself. Delete it afterwards.
steps: Click the palette icon (Appearance) in the left sidebar footer
Click the Muted text swatch, type #4c566a in its hex field and press Enter

subject: The TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT card as rows divided by hairlines, each name on the left and its chips on the right: Font family chips (Segoe UI chosen, Calibri, Georgia, Verdana, Trebuchet MS), Text size (Small, Default, Large), Density (Compact, Comfortable, Cozy), Corners (Sharp, Default, Round), and the Panel layout row with its hint and Reset layout.

subject: The IMPORT & EXPORT card with Copy JSON, Paste JSON, Save file… and Open file… buttons.

Scroll to the bottom of the pane

subject: Settings › Symbols with no set downloaded yet: the ICON SETS card with its note ('Each download fetches the icon package once (21.7 MB) …'), and set rows from 'Outline icons · set 1' ('MPL-2.0 · 288 icons · 243 KB') to 'Line icons · set 10', each with Download.

steps: Click Privacy & Data in the rail

subject: The success toast 'Backup saved in the backups folder: simulacra-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.db', breaking after the colon: the file name alone, no path.

subject: The Export bundle sheet: title and subtitle, WHAT TO EXPORT with Everything chosen in the segmented track, ALSO INCLUDE with two unticked rows, WILL BE WRITTEN with nine counts and the green 'Never included: credentials, API keys and AI provider settings.', then Cancel and Export….
region: The export sheet.

subject: The Date range scope: From and To fields holding the last 30 days and the chips Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, Last 365 days.

subject: ALSO INCLUDE with 'Include private journal' ticked and the amber warning that the journal is written into the bundle unencrypted.

subject: The Encrypted snapshot sheet: the explanation, PASSPHRASE with a masked passphrase, the four-part meter reading Strong and its tip, the repeat field filled, the amber 'If you lose this passphrase…' notice, Cancel and an enabled Create snapshot….
region: The snapshot sheet.
setup: Then Create snapshot… saves it to a temp folder for the restore shots.
steps: Type lantern orbit pickle granite meadow quiver in Passphrase (six words read Strong; four read Fair)
Type the same in Type it again

subject: The Restore snapshot sheet on its first step: the explanation, SNAPSHOT FILE with Choose file… and a .simsnap file name, the 'Passphrase of the snapshot' field, the verify hint, Cancel and Verify.
region: The restore sheet.
setup: The snapshot made in data-snapshot-sheet (passphrase 'lantern orbit pickle granite meadow quiver'), in a temp folder.
steps: Click Choose file… and pick the snapshot

subject: The Restore snapshot sheet after Verify: the green 'Verified. Snapshot from …: N posts, N profiles, N documents.' notice, the amber replace warning, Cancel and the red 'Restore and restart' button.
region: The restore sheet.
setup: Same snapshot as data-restore-choose. Click Cancel afterwards, not Restore and restart.
steps: Click Choose file… and pick the snapshot
Type lantern orbit pickle granite meadow quiver

subject: The Version history sheet of a vault document: the document title as subtitle, the VERSIONS list newest first (Current, Earlier version v1.1.0, Original v1.0.0 with their until … times), the Original row highlighted with no compare button, and the compare buttons (two crossing arrows) on the other rows, lit on Current, CHANGES FROM v1.0.0 TO Current with '+9 words −0 words', the Title: “…” → “…” note and the word diff with the added first sentence in green, then Close and Restore this version.
region: The history sheet.
setup: A vault document edited twice: in the Knowledge Vault open the Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus entry, click Edit, add ' (Ogden translation)' to its title and save; click Edit again, add 'Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent.' as a new first paragraph of its text and save.
